movement.title: Movement
movement.libraryHint: Pick a short one, all under 2 minutes.

session.completeBody: Your body thanks you. Back to it!

neck-roll.name: Neck release
neck-roll.summary: Ease neck tension from screen time.
steps: Sit tall and relax your shoulders.
Tilt your head to the right, ear toward shoulder, hold gently.
Tilt to the left and hold gently.
Drop your chin to your chest and roll your head slowly.

shoulder-roll.name: Shoulder rolls
shoulder-roll.summary: Wake up your shoulders and upper back.
steps: Shrug both shoulders up to your ears, hold 2 s, release.
Roll your shoulders backward in big circles.
Switch direction and roll forward.

standing-stretch.name: Full-body reach
standing-stretch.summary: Lengthen the spine and boost circulation.
steps: Stand up, feet hip-width apart.
Interlace your fingers and reach up high, breathe in.
Lean to the right, then to the left.
Lower your arms and breathe out slowly.

wrist-stretch.name: Wrist stretch
wrist-stretch.summary: For hands that type all day.
steps: Extend your right arm, palm facing out.
Gently pull the fingers back with your left hand.
Switch hands and repeat.
Circle both wrists slowly.

chest-opener.name: Chest opener
steps: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Draw your shoulders back, lift your chest, look ahead.
Hold and breathe deeply.

calf-raise.name: Calf raises
calf-raise.summary: Activate your calves after long sitting.
steps: Stand tall, lightly holding the desk if needed.
Rise onto your toes and hold for 2 s.
Lower slowly and repeat at a steady pace.

eye-rest.name: Eye rest
steps: Look away from the screen.
Focus on something about 6 metres away.
Blink slowly a few times, then close your eyes.

walk.name: Short walk
walk.summary: Walk a few laps and refill your water.
steps: Stand up and walk at an easy pace.
Relax your arms and let them swing.
Grab a glass of water on the way.
